text:
Maria: FYI — SI partner's appliance smoke tests started failing after we pushed the new driver bundle to the marketplace earlier today. Need quick alignment on pin + hotfix window. :frowning:
Ajay: ugh. which stack exactly? CUDA / driver / kernel combination? any logs / error snippets? :eyes:
Maria: repro snippet from their CI attached below (cut):
```
/opt/runtime/bin/serve --model gpt-neo --gpu 0
[ERROR] cuInit failed: CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime
Driver: 530.41.1
CUDA: 12.2
Kernel: 5.15.0-70-generic
Image: partner-appliance-2026-03-20
```
Li: saw similar on our side in early dogfood. Looks like a driver ABI change in 530.x that breaks the fallback path on that older kernel. We can reproduce on a 5.15 image. :+1:
Sam: possible short-term mitigation: set env var to force legacy kernel path in runtime: `REDWOOD_FORCE_LEGACY_CUDA=1` — that keeps sessions alive while we stage a driver pin. Also can validate with: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv`
Maria: confirmed the `REDWOOD_FORCE_LEGACY_CUDA=1` workaround lets their smoke tests proceed (they ran with a small batch). But it's not a long-term solution. They want a marketplace bundle they can pull that won't break existing appliance fleets.
Li: we have a hotfix candidate: driver 529.84.0-r2 (rebuilt with the old ABI shim). Can sign and produce a marketplace-compatible artifact by EOD PST if we get a canary window.
Priya: from partnerships/comm side — if we push a hotfix, do we need a joint announcement with the SI and cloud marketplace? Partner requests a short note for customers explaining the pin and that we're not changing APIs, just restoring compatibility. I can draft. :memo:
Ajay: propose plan: 1) canary release to 5% of marketplace images for 6 hours, monitor smoke tests + telemetry; 2) if green, promote to 100% with a rollback tag to previous driver; 3) update docs and comms. Anyone object?
Li: 5%/6h sounds fine. We should include an automated rollback trigger on error rate > 2% or GPU init failures. We can provide signed driver artifact and checksum.
Sam: I'll add an automated check in the runtime canary: abort if `cuInit` errors spike or if OOM counts increase by > 10%. Hook into console alerting. I'll post the quick check script in the canary runbook.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started by Li for artifact driver-529.84.0-r2 to marketplace-catalog v2.3.4-canary (5%) — build 2201 — watch: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/2201
Maria: excellent. Partner team will run their appliance smoke tests against the canary this afternoon. Priya — please hold off on external comms until we get canary result; internal heads-up ok.
Priya: acknowledged — will prep draft, hold send. If canary is green, propose a short joint notice: 1) what happened, 2) what we changed (pinned to 529.84.0-r2), 3) mitigation steps for customers who already applied 530.x.
Maria: next steps: Li ships signed artifact + checksum, Sam wires canary checks and alerts, Ajay owns rollback policy, Priya drafts comms, I'll coordinate partner test results and close the window. Thanks everyone — will update thread when partner confirms their smoke tests pass. :thumbsup:
